svg.title: How each guard is switched on and off
svg.desc: The abdication guard is opt-in: it runs only when abdication_guard_enabled is true in .agentic/config.json, which the shipped template sets, and an environment kill switch turns it off. The turn-shape guard is on unless turn_shape_guard_enabled is false, and also has an environment kill switch. The Skeptic round cap has no toggle and no kill switch; only an operator grant lets a unit past it. All three fail open on errors, except that the round cap denies a granted round when it cannot record it.

g.text: On, off, and the way past
Opt-in: config key must be true
Env kill switch turns it off
On unless the config key is false
Env kill switch turns it off
Past the cap: an operator grant
Errors fail open, with one round-cap exception.
